description: Source code for managing commands in a CLI or application, including loading, resolving symlinks, parsing frontmatter, and retrieving commands from different sources (built-in, global, project).

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Interface representing a command with metadata such as name, content, source, file path, description, argument hint, and mode.

classes.name: CommandFileInfo
classes.description: Interface representing information about a command file, including original and resolved paths.

methods.name: resolveCommandSymLink
methods.description: Recursively resolve a symbolic link to collect command file info, avoiding cyclic loops.

methods.name: resolveCommandDirectoryEntry
methods.description: Resolve directory entries to find markdown command files, supporting nested symlinks.

methods.name: tryResolveSymlinkedCommand
methods.description: Attempt to resolve a symlinked command file to its target path.

methods.name: getCommands
methods.description: Retrieve all available commands from built-in, global, and project directories with priority: project > global > built-in.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Retrieve a specific command by name, prioritizing project, then global, then built-in commands.

methods.name: tryLoadCommand
methods.description: Attempt to load a command file from a directory, supporting symlinks and parsing frontmatter.

methods.name: getCommandNames
methods.description: Get list of command names for autocomplete.

methods.name: scanCommandDirectory
methods.description: Scan a directory for command files, including symlinks, and add them to the commands map.

methods.name: getCommandNameFromFile
methods.description: Extract command name from filename by removing the .md extension.

methods.name: isMarkdownFile
methods.description: Check if a filename corresponds to a markdown file.
